title: Gaussian-Width Bounds for Offline-to-Online Linear Bandits
abstract: arXiv:2610.12990v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study how offline data can help online learning in stochastic linear bandits. We focus on partially covered offline data, where only $k$ of the $d$ feature directions are poorly covered. Existing analyses of algorithms based on phased elimination and optimism give regret bounds of order $\widetilde O(\sqrt{dkT})$ in this regime. We show that this dependence arises from loose control of the reward prediction error, and obtain tighter bounds using concentration of Lipschitz functions of Gaussian vectors. Based on this analysis, we develop a phased elimination algorithm with regret $\widetilde O(k\sqrt T)$. For the unit Euclidean ball, we prove a matching regret lower bound under partial coverage, as well as matching upper and lower bounds under uniform offline coverage. We also study pure exploration with offline data, providing algorithms and matching upper and lower bounds on simple regret for fixed-design algorithms and also for adap

translated_title: 离线到在线线性赌博机的高斯宽度界
translated_abstract: 我们研究离线数据如何帮助随机线性赌博机中的在线学习。我们关注部分覆盖的离线数据，即 $d$ 个特征方向中只有 $k$ 个方向的覆盖较差。现有基于分阶段消除和乐观原则的算法分析在此情形下给出的遗憾界为 $\widetilde O(\sqrt{dkT})$ 量级。我们证明这种依赖关系源于对奖励预测误差的宽松控制，并利用高斯向量的Lipschitz函数的集中性获得了更紧的界。基于此分析，我们开发了一种遗憾为 $\widetilde O(k\sqrt T)$ 的分阶段消除算法。对于单位欧氏球，我们证明了部分覆盖下匹配的遗憾下界，以及在均匀离线覆盖下匹配的上下界。我们还研究了利用离线数据的纯探索问题，为固定设计算法和自适应算法分别提供了简单遗憾的算法及匹配的上下界。
tldr: 该论文利用高斯向量Lipschitz函数的集中性改进了对奖励预测误差的控制，将部分覆盖离线数据下线性赌博机的遗憾界从 $\widetilde O(\sqrt{dkT})$ 提升至最优的 $\widetilde O(k\sqrt T)$，并给出了匹配的上下界。
en_tdlr: This paper tightens the control of reward prediction error via concentration of Lipschitz functions of Gaussian vectors, improving the regret bound for linear bandits with partially covered offline data from $\widetilde O(\sqrt{dkT})$ to the optimal $\widetilde O(k\sqrt T)$, with matching upper and lower bounds.
